scope: Source snapshots come from the measured commit recorded by the final build and timing session, independently of the later documentation checkout.
Reused dev3b validation retains its original dirty-worktree metadata; its compiled sources and all compiler/runtime artifact hashes match the clean final build exactly.
Final and reused validation logs/records, baseline/final raw traces, complete retained profile files, generated LLVM, exact command records and audit source/results are included.

Native binaries, runtime archives, interpreter binaries and toolchains are excluded. Their original paths and hashes remain in frozen records and audits; excluded files encountered in validation trees are also indexed here.
Raw final timing JSON is separately gzip-compressed without byte changes. The profile and timing audits retain their measurement limitations; instrumented elapsed times are not performance results.
Tar members are sorted with mode0644, uid/gid/mtime0 and empty owner names. Gzip filename is empty and mtime0. The manifest uses the recorded session completion time, not packaging wall time.

Audits requiring executable/toolchain bytes need the external frozen local paths. Published raw timing/trace/source bytes support statistical recomputation, trace parsing and hash verification without those binaries.
